quotes.quote: I support housing and economic development that serve our community while respecting our historic downtown and neighborhoods—not projects that put special interests ahead of Petalumans.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: The City Council's responsibility is to provide oversight of city leadership and ensure public funds are spent wisely.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: As Mayor, I will ensure residents' voices are heard and work with the City Council to make responsible, common-sense decisions.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: Petaluma deserves safe neighborhoods, well-maintained streets and infrastructure, transparent and accountable government, and thoughtful planning that preserves the character of the city we love.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: I will take that responsibility seriously and work to restore trust, strengthen our local economy, and protect the quality of life that makes Petaluma unique.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: I've supported affordable housing.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: Serving on the County Homelessness and Mental Health boards, I brought funding for Petaluma's SAFE Team and other programs that serve the unhoused.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: I envision a Petaluma that leads on street repairs, climate, affordable housing and investments across town.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: I'm dedicated to the safety of All residents and am working with business owners to boost economic development in our historic downtown – efforts that include the Trestle.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: As our only citywide representative, I promise to pay attention to the needs of all residents.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: As a small business owner myself, support for small, local, family owned businesses is top of mind.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: I believe in transparency and accountability, fiscal responsibility, and strong leadership.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: I will protect the things the voters voted for - roads, Urban Growth Boundary, responsible growth, and keeping things like Measure J away.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statements, Petaluma Mayor

quotes.quote: As your Mayor, my highest priority will be ensuring Windsor remains the safest community in Sonoma County.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statement, Windsor Mayor

quotes.quote: Regarding the Town’s finances, I have proven myself to be a fiscally disciplined leader.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statement, Windsor Mayor

quotes.quote: Furthermore, I will continue to prioritize infrastructure investments to guarantee our roads, drinking water, and wastewater systems are topnotch.
quotes.sourceTitle: Sonoma County Registrar of Voters, Candidate Statement, Windsor Mayor

quotes.quote: I am running to see these commitments through to completion, ensuring the promises made to you are promises kept.
quotes.sourceTitle: Campaign website, Tanya Potter for Windsor Mayor

quotes.quote: Strengthened support for Belmont's small businesses and deepened partnerships with Chamber San Mateo County.
quotes.sourceTitle: KQED Voter Guide, Belmont races (excerpt of candidate statement)

quotes.quote: I'll continue to engage you, the community I serve, in an accountable, transparent and dynamic manner as we shape, adapt, and envision Belmont's future for decades to come.
quotes.sourceTitle: KQED Voter Guide, Belmont races (excerpt of candidate statement)

quotes.quote: We must strengthen our public safety units, our economic development, and our infrastructure.
quotes.sourceTitle: City of Milpitas, Ballot Designation and Candidate Statement 2026

quotes.quote: We need to strengthen our traffic enforcement and create a parking enforcement division.
quotes.sourceTitle: City of Milpitas, Ballot Designation and Candidate Statement 2026

quotes.quote: As we meet these requirements, our priority must be protecting the character of our neighborhoods.
quotes.sourceTitle: City of Milpitas, Ballot Designation and Candidate Statement 2026

quotes.quote: Milpitas has lost 10 Senior Executives in the past 5 years, resulting in significant costs.
quotes.sourceTitle: City of Milpitas, Ballot Designation and Candidate Statement 2026

quotes.quote: Inflation is a concern for our residents, and one way to address it is by accelerating existing development projects, which can help reduce the tax burden on our residents.

quotes.quote: The city has violated numerous Municipal codes, and this must stop.
quotes.sourceTitle: City of Milpitas, Ballot Designation and Candidate Statement 2026

quotes.quote: I have led efforts to reduce our structural deficit by 45% without cutting jobs and services.
quotes.sourceTitle: City of Milpitas, Ballot Designation and Candidate Statement 2026

quotes.quote: Milpitas families deserve a Mayor who listens, delivers results, and puts residents first.

quotes.quote: We deserve safe neighborhoods, dependable city services, well-maintained roads and parks, responsible growth, and a government that uses your taxpayer dollars wisely.
quotes.sourceTitle: City of Milpitas, Ballot Designation and Candidate Statement 2026

quotes.quote: Support fully-funded police and emergency services, effective public safety partnerships, and emergency preparedness.

quotes.quote: Prioritize responsive city services, well-maintained parks and roads, clean neighborhoods, and affordability.
quotes.sourceTitle: Campaign website, Santosh Sahoo for Milpitas Mayor

quotes.sourceTitle: Campaign website, Santosh Sahoo for Milpitas Mayor

quotes.quote: Take care of the small businesses, help them as much as possible, they will improve also; they will progress
quotes.sourceTitle: Milpitas Beat, Voltaire Montemayor launches sixth campaign for Milpitas mayor

quotes.quote: I will: 1) Continue working to foster an environment that provides opportunities for businesses to create new jobs and opens the door for companies to expand or relocate here; 2) Continue supporting our youth sports programs and expand recreational tourism; 3) Ensure public safety gets the resources needed to keep us safe.
quotes.sourceTitle: City of Morgan Hill, Mark Turner Candidate Statement 2026

quotes.quote: Every week I meet with residents, business leaders, nonprofit organizations, community leaders, and our faith community to learn their ideas and concerns, then I act on them.
quotes.sourceTitle: City of Morgan Hill, Mark Turner Candidate Statement 2026

quotes.quote: My priorities are straightforward: protect our town from reckless development, support local workers and small businesses, invest in infrastructure that serves residents, and make sure every decision puts people first.

quotes.quote: I’m stepping forward because I believe leadership should be accountable, transparent, and grounded in the lives of the people who actually live here.
